blocks.title: Software development tools
blocks.text: Software development tools woh programs ya applications hain jo software banane ke marahil mein madad karte hain. Yeh code likhne, badalne, test, debug aur sambhalne ke liye istemal hote hain ta ke software theek aur kaarkardagi se chale.

blocks.prompt: Paanch kaam bataiye jin mein software development tools madad dete hain.
blocks.explanation: Code likhna, badalna (edit), test karna, debug karna aur sambhalna.

items: Development tools: programs jo code likhne, badalne, test, debug aur sambhalne mein madad dete hain.
